content.title: About
content.content: Seabreeze is a light non‑alcoholic beverage with a sea‑breeze flavor, made from natural citrus extracts, sea salt, and gentle carbonation. It refreshes, contains no sugar, and is suitable for all ages.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The recipe uses sea salt harvested from pristine oceanic sources.
Flavor is created by a blend of lime, grapefruit and a hint of mint.
Seabreeze was first launched at the International Healthy Food Expo in 2022.
The drink contains no artificial sweeteners or colorings.
With low calories (15 kcal/100 ml) it is popular among athletes.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Gentle carbonation and electrolytes from sea salt help maintain the body’s water balance.

items.title: Low Calorie Content
items.content: Ideal for those watching their calorie intake while still enjoying flavor.

items.title: Vitamin C
items.content: Citrus extracts provide a modest amount of vitamin C, supporting immunity.

items.title: Antioxidant Effect
items.content: Flavonoids from grapefruit have antioxidant properties.

items.title: Refreshing Sensation
items.content: Mint and lime create a fresh feeling that reduces thirst.

items.title: Citrus Allergy
items.content: People allergic to citrus may experience a reaction.

items.title: Sodium Content
items.content: Although the amount of salt is small, individuals with hypertension should consider total sodium intake.

items.title: Carbonation
items.content: Carbonated drinks can cause stomach discomfort in some individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve Seabreeze chilled; optionally add a lime wedge or a sprig of mint. It works as a standalone drink, in non‑alcoholic cocktails, or as a refreshing accompaniment to light meals.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 5‑7 days.
